versions.changelog: Security: email sending risk warnings, user consent documentation
Security improvements: clarified data storage warnings, updated security documentation, fixed descriptions to match actual behavior.
Plaintext-at-rest warning on startup, delete requires --force confirmation, 0600 permissions on data files. 14 tests.

Initial release: 14/14 self-tests, email composition, parsing (headers, body, attachments), status tracking, batch loading. Fixed module.exports (removed nonexistent sendEmail). Zero external dependencies.
